stem: A Voltmarkt store carries 4 smart speaker models. A fifth model is sold only on the webshop, but the stock table still has a row with 0 units for it in this store every day. In September (30 days) the 4 models the store carries closed with 0 units on 3, 0, 9 and 6 days. What is the store's stockout rate for smart speakers in September? Give a percentage with 1 decimal.
